info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Gap Analysis Model Retrieval API enables users to fetch specific gap analysis models based on a unique identifier, represented by param1 in the path. This endpoint is crucial for applications that need to evaluate financial gaps and disparities in various banking scenarios. It streamlines the process of retrieving models and empowers financial analysts and developers by providing direct access to relevant analytical resources. Typical consumers include financial institutions, analysts, and developers seeking to integrate gap analysis functionality into their systems.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific gap analysis model.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of a specific gap analysis model identified by its unique ID. The response includes comprehensive information about the model, aiding in understanding its structure and findings.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to perform a GET operation for gap analysis on the specified model identified by RES-100045. It expects a JSON payload that conforms to the defined schema.
